# exp5_candidate_completion results (discovery-campaign completion)

**Status: discovery-campaign completion under the exp5 protocol; NOT main evidence and not preregistered main evidence. EWAS-v2 (`docs/EWAS_V2_RESULTS.md`) is the main evidence.** Generated by `paper/scripts/compile_ewas_results.py` from `outputs/exp5_candidate_completion/run_001/` (summary CSV and run manifest only; the candidate OOF parquet is not read), `outputs/exp5_candidate_completion/regression/VERDICT.json` and the stored exp5 files; read-only, nothing re-run. Registration: `docs/EXP5_CANDIDATE_COMPLETION_REGISTRATION.md` incl. Amendments 1-2. Repo HEAD at compilation `3530077`. Source hashes: `paper/registry/exp5_completion_results_manifest.json`.

Reading convention: delta = candidate minus comparator (positive favours the candidate); CIs are the exp5 bootstrap CIs as produced by the run (B=10,000, pairs resampled within chromosome, same index vector for every arm). Reading: **CI>0** candidate better, **CI<0** comparator better, **spans 0** no difference detected. The `p_boot` / BH `q` columns are in the CSV as descriptive values. No aggregate score, no pooling across sets. All 13 evaluable sets are shown in both directions.

## 1. Integrity

39 automated checks, **0 failed** (`exp5_completion_results_integrity.csv`).

- Regression (18 cells: SLE and Hannum x seeds 17001-17003 x CpGPT-512, DeepCpG-128, functional-256): verdict **PASS** under Amendment 2 (criterion: pairs/folds identical, |dAUROC| <= 5e-4, Spearman >= 0.9999). Observed max |dAUROC| = 2.441e-04 (limit 5e-4), min Spearman = 0.999987 (limit 0.9999), cells failed 0/18; max |dscore| = 2.10e-03 (informative only; the former 1e-5 criterion was superseded). Pairs/folds identical in 18/18 cells.
- Amendment 1 (fold fidelity, bugfix): the legacy GroupKFold shim reproduces the stored `fold` column in 3120/3120 cells (5,785,200 rows), 0 mismatches (1/1 check; run manifest `stored_fold_cells_mismatching_shim` = 0). The first regression attempt with sklearn 1.9.1 GroupKFold failed on `fold` (log kept in `regression/`).
- Run manifest: git HEAD `3530077`; candidate store sha256 `fa3a816338ce2c2c...` == pins; frozen manifest sha256 `0a6d9c4f2b6f2a05...` == pins; seeds 17001..17020, B = 10000; classifier StandardScaler(fold-wise)+LogReg(C=1,max_iter=2000); folds GroupKFold(5) by chromosome; skipped (no matched support): ewas_atlas_ovarian_cancer, ewas_catalog_coronary_heart_disease, ewas_catalog_schizophrenia.
- Identical pairs/folds versus the stored comparators in every cell: asserted by the run before any bootstrap (`cpg_idx`, `pair_id`, `y_true`, `fold`, `chromosome` equal per variant x set x seed x comparator, otherwise abort with `ABORT_pairs_or_folds_differ.json`); the run finished (`run_001.log`: done) and no abort file exists (1/1). This compilation did not re-check the row identities (it does not read the OOF parquets).
- Stored exp5 files unchanged: the 7 files' sha256 recomputed now == `exp5_pins.json` 7/7; manifest snapshot before == after the run 7/7.
- Comparator numbers re-derived by the run from stored float32 OOF vs the stored exp5 summary: max |dAUROC| = 3.36e-05, max |dCI bound| = 4.13e-04 (registered ~1e-4 level); comparator concordance equals the registry-v2 derived values (max |diff| 4.9e-11).
- Support tiers == `exp5_support_tiers_v2.csv` 1/1; no NaN in values 1/1; delta point == candidate - comparator point (max |diff| 3.6e-16).
- Timing (file mtimes, UTC): EWAS-v2 tag commit 2026-10-05T17:31:27+02:00; exp5 verdict 2026-10-05 15:27:16 UTC; exp5 run summary 2026-10-05 15:34:27 UTC; EWAS-v2 candidate arm manifest 2026-10-05 15:34:08 UTC; EWAS-v2 state.json 2026-10-05 15:45:20 UTC. The EWAS-v2 tag precedes both runs (freeze ordering of registration section 10 satisfied); the two runs were executed in overlapping windows, so file times cannot establish which result was opened first; per the registration neither run's design was altered after seeing the other.

## 2. Per set x variant: AUROC and concordance (95% CI)

`base` = exp5 matching (chromosome x CpG context x gene region x core-breadth decile); `probe` = the exp5 probe-type-matched variant. Candidate: computed by this run (current libraries). Comparators: stored exp5 OOF scores (original libraries); concordance for comparators derived by registry v2, for the candidate computed by the run (the run summary holds both). AUPRC is sensitivity only (prevalence 0.5 by construction; no CI). N = mean matched positives over the 20 draws (cap 2,000).

## 4. Caveats

- Numerical fidelity: the candidate is fitted with the CURRENT libraries while comparators enter with their stored scores (original libraries). Candidate - comparator deltas can therefore carry a systematic fidelity error of order <= ~3e-4 AUROC (regression: max |dAUROC| 2.44e-04, 5e-4 tolerance, Amendment 2). Negligible against CIs of order >= 0.01.
- Matching is not neutral. Strata = chromosome x CpG context x gene region x core-breadth decile. Context, gene region and core breadth are INPUTS of the functional store but NOT of the candidate, CpGPT or DeepCpG. The matching removes the signal the functional arm holds as direct input (handicapping functional-256) while the candidate (histone/DNase tracks encode promoter/island/breadth implicitly) is scored under strata built partly from features it lacks. The net direction is not known a priori; candidate - functional deltas are supplementary and potentially biased; candidate vs CpGPT/DeepCpG share the same matching.
- Discovery-campaign completion, NOT main evidence: pairs, folds, probe (StandardScaler + LogReg C=1) and bootstrap are the old exp5 design (cap 2,000 pairs, 20 non-independent draws; GC, CpG density, TSS distance not matched). p/q are descriptive. It was run after the EWAS-v2 freeze and cannot motivate changes to it.
- Old exp5 caveats carry over: negatives are unlisted, not unassociated; sets overlap (lung in smoking, T2D in BMI); EWAS cohort overlap with GEO/TCGA unverified; CpGPT is methylation-pretrained; the candidate SVD is label-free and transductive; 849 all-zero candidate rows kept; chromosomes 20-22 are out-of-fit for the SVD.
- Candidate store float32 vs comparators float16 (all cast to float32 for the probe): a minor precision advantage for the candidate.
- Three sets (ovarian, CHD, schizophrenia) have no matched support in exp5 and are skipped; Hannum and T2D (insufficient) and SLE (exploratory) are reported but supplementary.

## 5. Consistency with EWAS-v2 (same sets, two designs)

For each of the 13 evaluable sets the candidate AUROC and the sign / reading of candidate - comparator (AUROC) are compared across designs: exp5 (`base` and `probe`) against EWAS-v2 MAIN and S1. Agreement is described only; the designs differ (matching strata, caps, probe C selection, folds, bootstrap), so no interpretation beyond description is offered. ## 6. Data dictionary (`paper/registry/exp5_completion_results_*.csv`)

- `exp5_completion_results_per_set_arm.csv`: variant (base|probe), set, support_tier (fixed from the pre-existing exp5 base counts), matched_positives_mean, arm, arm_label, auroc + CI (exp5 bootstrap) + between-seed SD, concordance + CI, auprc (sensitivity, no CI), auprc_baseline_prevalence, comparator_source, source_file.
- `exp5_completion_results_deltas.csv`: variant, set, support_tier, comparator, metric (auroc|concordance), delta (candidate - comparator, mean over 20 draws), ci_lo/ci_hi (exp5 bootstrap), reading, between_seed_sd, n_seeds_delta_positive, n_seeds, p_boot_descriptive, q_bh_descriptive (BH across sets within variant x comparison x metric, as produced by the run), source_file.
- `exp5_completion_results_vs_ewas_v2.csv`: set, support_tier, exp5_variant, ewas_design (main|S1), comparator, candidate AUROC in both designs, delta/CI/reading in both designs, sign_agrees, reading_agrees, source_file.
- `exp5_completion_results_integrity.csv`: check_id, scope, item, expected, observed, passed, source_file.
- `exp5_completion_results_manifest.json`: git HEAD, tags, sha256 of every source file read and of every output written (including this document).
